hero-description: We highlight organizations doing important work in Colombia.
reasons-title: Common reasons some people choose not to donate
reason-1: Not knowing how the funds will be used.
reason-3: Not knowing whom to contact about a large donation.
callout: If your organization directly helps communities in Colombia and needs funding to respond to urgent requests, we want to help communicate your work.
featured-title: How can my organization be featured?
featured-body: Submit the application form. You may complete it in Spanish, and our team can help translate it into English.
improve-title: How can I improve our donation page?
item-1-title: A brief description of your organization
item-1-body: Include relevant background, institutional support, and previous accomplishments.
item-2: A clear explanation of how the funds will be used.
item-3: The approximate amount you are trying to raise.
item-4-title: Public links that help donors evaluate the request
item-4-body: Share previous campaigns, posts with evidence, endorsements from institutions or recognized people, and press coverage.
item-5-body: Verify that the information is accurate, clearly organized, and easy to use. Offer familiar, secure options available in Colombia.
item-6-body: With permission, share the contact information of a responsible person who can answer questions.
